responsibility: Provides the shared interprocedural propagation framework for call-argument, constant, bit, range, and aggregate-value summaries. It owns the node and edge summary stores, IPA-CP data structures, LTO-streamed propagation caches, and the routines that update parameter facts and transformation metadata used by several IPA passes.
same_name_distinction: Contains the main implementation of the shared IPA propagation framework declared in ipa-prop.h: it owns the concrete summary objects and executes parameter/jump-function analysis, propagation, LTO summary handling, and IPCP transformations, rather than just defining the framework’s data structures and interfaces.
